scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rg-media/api" "npm run dev -w @rg-media/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rg-media/database && npm run build -w @rg-media/api && npm run build -w @rg-media/web
